text:
hana_fin: Vendor 'Seoul Insights' submitted invoice SI-9091 and withheld 3% local tax (원천징수) on our partner rebate. They are requesting gross-up per contract. Invoice in bill.com.
jin_sales: link: https://app.bill.com/inv/SI-9091
hana_fin: Contract clause says we "shall gross-up" for required withholdings. Can Korea WHT be reimbursed operationally?
sung_legal: Paste clause? Also check if vendor is registered in KR and whether treaty benefits apply.
hana_fin: Clause: "If Customer is required to withhold any taxes, Customer will increase payments so Provider receives full invoiced amount."
min_tax_kr: Quick tax note: typical WHT rate on service fees to residents = 3% local withholding for certain payments, and 20% for nonresidents (reduced by treaty). We need vendor biz자등록증 (business registration) and 원천징수영수증 (withholding receipt) or bank remittance to tax office to validate. If vendor is a Korean resident entity, 3% looks plausible.
tax-bot: Automated check: vendor country=KR; invoice currency=KRW; flagged rate=3% (common for resident service providers). Requested docs: business registration (사업자등록증), proof of withholding payment (원천징수영수증 또는 납부영수증), copy of contract.
ap_team: From AP POV: If contract requires gross-up we can process a top-up payment. Example: inv amount 1,000,000 KRW, vendor withheld 30,000 KRW; we pay gross 1,000,000 KRW and remit 30,000 KRW to tax office. If vendor already retained 30,000, we pay 30,000 top-up. Need supporting docs to record WHT credit.
jin_sales: Vendor says municipality issued the withholding receipt but can only provide it next week. They asked for expedited partial reimbursement to help cashflow.
sung_legal: We should not prepay without docs. Approve gross-up once vendor provides 사업자등록증 + 원천징수영수증 or bank proof. If they insist, require signed indemnity and senior management approval.
hana_fin: i'll request the docs and ask them to reissue invoice showing: gross amount, withheld amount, and a separate gross-up line.
ap_team: Tag cost center 'Partner Rebates - APAC' and mark bill.com status 'tax-docs-pending'.
min_tax_kr: Also confirm VAT implications: if this is service rebate (non-VATable), check whether issued invoice included VAT. If VAT present, VAT handling differs.
jin_sales: pinged vendor for docs and indemnity template if needed.
hana_fin: thanks all :thumbsup:
system_bot: Invoice SI-9091 uploaded by seoul-ops at 2025-02-14 08:33 KST.
